character: tall spotted giraffe in a loose grey tie at a white mailbox on a post; the neck sweeps like a crane arm; two thirds of frame height
cast: one darker giraffe without a tie; in every window, large at the lens, never still, never talks
motion_rule: the paper is never still: it is pulled, whipped, torn or thrown; the tied giraffe leads, the other adds to his move; action never stops in the silent windows; no window ends in a pose; shot size never repeats
props: a paper bill roll printed with big black columns of digits down its length; the mailbox lid claps
environment: noon savanna, pale sand, acacia, bleached sky, hard white sun

audio.delivery: male voice, bored deadpan, 4.4 syllables per second inside a line, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: налоги is na-LO-gi; наклоняться is na-klo-NYAT-sa
audio.pacing: each line fills its own window at full speed; the windows without a line are SILENT, not slowed speech; nothing said after 7.9
audio.lip_sync: lips shape every syllable, mouth shut in the silent beats, never a voice-over

timeline.a: the lid claps open and the digit roll fires into the lens while his head dives from the top of frame to meet it
timeline.c: macro, ripped up with his head

timeline.a: the other giraffe bites the loose end and runs backwards, stretching the roll into a taut band over the whole frame, digits streaming past the lens
the two haul the band in opposite directions, it jerks tight and whips the lens, hooves bursting sand under it
he throws his head up, the band snapping straight along his neck, the other swinging off the far end
the other puffs its belly out at the lens and struts past on stiff legs, the band bouncing over its back
he bats the roll and it swings over the post, digits blurring
he pinches the sheet in his lips and it rips down the middle, the other catching the torn half at the lens
timeline.c: macro on the tear, drifts out

timeline.a: his forelegs slide wider, sand kicking into the lens
he shakes the paper down its whole length, the other jumping through it
the roll slaps flat on the sand, dust bursting into the lens
his neck starts folding down, the horizon rolling up the frame with it
he grinds his muzzle along the ground, the other at the lens pressing his head lower
he rolls the sheet into a scroll and swallows it, the lump travelling down his whole neck
the lid blows open, a paper avalanche pours over both
only his head is above the drift, digits over his eyes, he chews them flat

must_appear: big black digits down the whole roll, readable; the paper moving in every second; both giraffes in frame while he speaks; the avalanche burying him
negative_prompt: a roll hanging still, a standing pose, a second with nothing moving, the second giraffe out of frame or frozen, night, dim light, a blank paper roll, letters or Cyrillic on the paper, static camera, subtitles, English speech, drawn-out vowels, speech in the silent beats, any word after 7.9, deformed anatomy
